integrity: Exact finite symbolic identities are supported by a standalone checker; infinite and geometric conclusions are established by the accompanying algebraic proof, not by finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: Reduced branch components, generic degree and monodromy only; no complete scheme-theoretic branch multiplicities, singularity stratification of the second component, or explicit Bernstein–Sato ideal. Historical priority not independently audited.
title: Branch geometry and full symmetric monodromy of the Shi–Xu–Zuo polynomial map
